Definition: probably from G1 (as a particle of union) and the base of G4120; properly, folded together, i.e. single (figuratively, clear):--single.
BiblicalUsage: Haplous means single, sound, healthy, and Jesus uses it for the eye. In Matthew 6:22 he says if the eye is single the whole body is full of light, and in Luke 11:34 he repeats it: the light of the body is the eye, and a sound eye fills the body with light.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a single eye is a life that looks at one thing, and the light that follows is the proof that I am looking in the right direction.
